title: Inventory of a Playmobil set (format v1)
description: An inventory as rag-mobil reads it (--inventory-url, --inventory-file, cache) and writes it (--inventory-json). See docs/inventory-format.md. Unknown fields are ignored.

set_number.description: Set number, digits only (1 to 8). Must be the one requested.

release_date.description: Release date as free text (PlaymoDB: YYYY/MM), null if unknown.

parts.description: Contents of the box, one entry per reference. Must not be empty.

source_url.description: URL where a human can check the inventory (or any identifier of the source).

number.description: Piece reference, unique within the set; the LLM cites it in its plan.

color.description: Color, null if unknown or not applicable.

quantity.description: Number of copies in the box, null if unknown.

category.description: Category as free text. Klicky or figure (case-insensitive): a figure, hence a possible character. Paper: instructions, left out of the prompt.

components.description: Sub-items of the piece (a figure's wig, hat…), possibly empty.

image.description: Absolute URL of an image of the piece, null or absent if none. Not read by the prompt: used for display.
